title: Corvan Grain: October sea shipments down 62% on last year

facts.subject: October sea shipments
facts.statement: Corvan Grain reports that its sea shipments of wheat and maize in October 2026 were 62% below the same month a year earlier.

source_ref.text_snippet: Corvan Grain reports that its sea shipments of wheat and maize in October 2026 were 62% below the same month a year earlier.

facts.subject: Corridor Agreement and strike
facts.statement: The fall follows the end of the Corridor Agreement on 10 September and the strike at Orvan Grain Port that began on 14 September.

source_ref.text_snippet: The fall follows the end of the Corridor Agreement on 10 September and the strike at Orvan Grain Port that began on 14 September.

facts.subject: Company statement
facts.statement: A spokesperson said the company wanted to correct what it called exaggerated accounts of the disruption.

source_ref.text_snippet: A spokesperson said the company wanted to correct what it called exaggerated accounts of the disruption.

validation_notes: Citation repaired: quote found in ¶6, not cited ¶5

facts.subject: Shipping figures
facts.statement: The company's statement does not give a monthly breakdown by product, and it does not say how much of the fall is due to the strike rather than the end of the agreement.

source_ref.text_snippet: The company's statement does not give a monthly breakdown by product, and it does not say how much of the fall is due to the strike rather than the end of the agreement.
